title: W2: agent definitions compiled into dispatch contracts, per-harness exporters, initial generic agent catalog

AC1.note: src/agents/schema.test.ts asserts validator enforces every field and agrees with schemas/agent-definition.schema.json (required, enums, pattern, additionalProperties); merged in #684 (097cb54d), CI green

AC2.note: src/agents/compile.spawn-subagent.test.ts instantiates the real spawn_subagent tool; compiled input keys subset of inputSchema.properties; field->destination table covers every definition field (input or policy sidecar with explicit enforcement record)

AC3.note: PROMPT_DEFENSE_BASELINE single constant (src/agents/baseline.ts); baseline.test.ts + export.test.ts: every bundled agent x every target contains it verbatim exactly once; near-copy detector; bodies with baseline text rejected

AC4.note: agentExportSupport reads the agents surface state via the matrix classifier; export.test.ts stubs an unverified runtime -> instruction-only prose with provenance comment

AC5.note: src/agents/verify.test.ts: unknown-tool / unknown-skill fail closed with named reasons, CLI exit non-zero (agents-catalog-commands.test.ts); agent-catalogue-xref.test.ts extended to resolve against loadAgentCatalog, existing assertions unchanged

AC6.note: verify: generated origin without sourceRef -> origin-missing-source-ref; invalid id -> invalid-source-ref; missing W1 pack dir src/gdskills/bundled/stacks/<id>/ -> stack-pack-missing (lstat, no symlink escape); injectable resolver; gate-cleared/retired status deferred to Wave 4 with W1

AC7.note: schema/compile use isModelTier/parseModelTier from src/gdskills/model-tier.ts; compile.model-tier.test.ts proves no compiled output (any target) contains a model name; Claude model: inherit, other hosts omit model

AC8.note: keryx agents list/show/export/verify implemented (src/commands/agents-catalog.ts) with --json, export --dry-run/--force, refuse-unmanaged; agents-catalog-commands.test.ts + unchanged agent-commands.test.ts pass; cli-reference coverage green in CI

AC9.note: exporters for claude/codex/kiro/opencode/keryx-shell per first-party docs in registry sourceDocs; opt-in agents surfaces (SurfaceAdapter.optIn) claude native, codex/kiro/opencode adapter; default install unchanged; matrix regenerated, integrations matrix --check passes

AC10.note: bun ./src/cli.ts agents verify --json -> ok=true, 10/10 bundled generic agents (architect, planner, code-explorer, tdd-guide, refactor-cleaner, silent-failure-hunter, doc-updater, security-reviewer, performance-reviewer, e2e-runner)

AC11.note: manual run: 10 agents x 4 host runtimes exported into a temp repo + canonical defs under .metaproject/agents -> keryx security audit-harness: 0 findings, coverage complete, agent-definitions scanned 50 files; export.test.ts asserts zero findings, full pathsScanned coverage, no coverage errors

AC12.note: journal records owner acceptance of D-2; docs/requirements/keryx-multi-agent-engine/README.md carries the D-2 revision note beside the non-goal; docs/docs/guides/agent-catalog.md + cli-reference agents catalog section; check-doc-links 0 broken, mkdocs --strict green
